info.name: MealOrder API - Milestone 2
info.description: Koleksi uji Backend API MealOrder (ZeroBug). Jalankan folder berurutan dari atas ke bawah (Collection Runner). Prasyarat: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed dengan MEAL_SEED_CATALOG=true dan MEAL_SEED_DEV_ACCOUNTS=true di .env lokal.

item.name: 1. Auth (token)

exec: pm.test("role tetap customer meski dikirim admin", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql("customer"); });
pm.test("Error email dan password", function () { var e = pm.response.json().errors; pm.expect(e).to.have.property("email"); pm.expect(e).to.have.property("password"); });
